SmaRT Ride, Via-operated on-demand microtransit launched Jan 2020 (Via press release: "the largest on-demand microtransit system in America with 42 vehicles"), ended operations Dec 31, 2024 per CBS News Sacramento: "SmaRT Ride's operating cost per passenger is over $47, almost five times more than our fixed-route bus system"; "annual operating cost of $8.4 million while serving less than 1% of system ridership." Replaced by a Rideshare Voucher Program pilot (funding-securing phase as of the article; not a Via product). CBS article does not itself name Via, but via_news.csv press releases from 2020-2022 establish Via as the SmaRT Ride operator throughout its life.
